column2: Seamless repeating wallpaper: Yayoi Kusama 1968 happening poster style, dense hand painted polka dots of many sizes in red, white and black over cream paper, a few dots overlapping, slight brush texture, flat front view, edge to edge pattern, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper: Yayoi Kusama infinity net painting, thousands of tiny white scalloped loops over deep red, with big yellow and black pumpkin dots scattered, hand painted acrylic texture, flat front view, edge to edge, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper: a SoHo 1979 wall layered like a Jean-Michel Basquiat painting, scrawled black oil stick crowns, skulls, arrows, copyright symbols, crossed out words, torn xerox posters, wheat paste, raw brick showing through, flat front view, edge to edge.

Seamless repeating wallpaper in the style of Jean-Michel Basquiat: bright yellow and red acrylic fields, black three point crowns, anatomical diagrams, grids of crossed out words like COUNTED and N3W, copyright marks, flat front view, edge to edge.

Seamless repeating wallpaper: white chalk line drawings on matte black paper in the style of Keith Haring subway drawings, radiant babies, barking dogs, dancing figures with motion lines, chalk dust smudges, flat front view, edge to edge, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper in the style of Keith Haring murals: bold black outlined interlocking dancing figures filled with flat orange, red, yellow, green and blue, motion lines, hearts, flat front view, edge to edge, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper: Japanese woodblock print pattern after Hokusai, Prussian blue curling waves with white claw foam, pale beige paper grain, soft faded edges, flat front view, edge to edge, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper: a Hokusai woodblock print of a storm surge, rows of Prussian blue waves with clawed white foam, rain lines, tiny boats, beige paper fibres, flat front view, edge to edge, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper in the style of Roy Lichtenstein: giant red Ben-Day dots on white, thick black outlines, flat yellow and blue panels, a brushstroke motif, printed comic texture, flat front view, edge to edge, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper in the style of Roy Lichtenstein: comic panels with blue Ben-Day dots, yellow explosion bursts, red rays, black outlines, empty speech balloons, flat front view, edge to edge, no letters.

Seamless repeating wallpaper: a surreal 1939 department store damask after Salvador Dali, melting gold pocket watches, crutches, ants, lobsters and lips on deep crimson silk, gilt thread, flat front view, edge to edge, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper after Salvador Dali: endless desert under a hard sky, long shadows, melting clocks draped over branches, elephants on spindly legs, gold and ochre, oil paint texture, flat front view, edge to edge.
Seamless repeating wallpaper: crumpled silver aluminium foil and silver painted brick like the 1964 Silver Factory, hard flash reflections, gaffer tape, flat front view, edge to edge, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper in the style of Andy Warhol silkscreens: a grid of identical soup cans labelled N3W SOUP and eye flowers repeated in hot pink, yellow, cyan and orange, misregistered ink, flat front view, edge to edge.

Seamless repeating wallpaper in the style of Vincent van Gogh: thick impasto swirling blue and yellow brushstrokes, starry spirals, cypress green flames, visible paint ridges, flat front view, edge to edge, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper in the style of Vincent van Gogh: a night sky of spiralling stars and crescent moons in cobalt, ultramarine and chrome yellow impasto, flat front view, edge to edge, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper after Picasso's 1919 stage design period: earthy ochre, rose and cream flat shapes, a Spanish bullring arch, guitars, mandolins and masks in synthetic cubist planes, distemper paint, flat front view, edge to edge, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper in analytical cubist style after Picasso: fractured grey, brown and ochre planes, faceted city windows and faces seen from several angles at once, charcoal lines, flat front view, edge to edge, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper: black and white spray paint stencils in the style of Banksy on a Central Park stone wall, rats with paint rollers, a girl with a red heart balloon, drips, flat front view, edge to edge, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper: a Meatpacking District brick wall layered with Banksy style black stencils, rats, a boy with a hammer, a heart balloon in red, drips, peeling posters, flat front view, edge to edge, no letters.
